data.body:
Triage 2026-11-18 (session 3d705fec, cluster A3). No code was changed under this ticket.

Method: I read the full traceback of every one of the 242 `unclassified.args` entries from sweep job 133312625052 (run 43871224211, at b4e0d01b649) and matched the whole traceback, not just the summary line, against class signatures. All 242 node ids appear in that log.

First-match counts (signature regexes over the full traceback):
- text-encoding: 66. For example, `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step7_class_review.py` and `test_store_write_unmerged_recovery.py` read the hatch-generated `_build_commit` file, which was written as cp1252 (byte 0x97, an em dash) and then read as UTF-8. hatch_build.py:112 `write_text` passes no encoding.
- posix-api: 19. Examples: `test_gate_admission_09da.py` "advisory locking (fcntl) unavailable"; `test_doctor_locks.py` "holder process never took lock".
- posix-shell: 14.
- posix-permissions: 4.
- file-locks: 2.
- `WindowsPath(`/backslash matches: 98. This bucket is not reliable, because a `tmp_path` repr matches it. Each needs a per-test read before it is moved.
- Still unknown: 32. tests/unit/test_snapshot_git_watchdog_d33f.py (4) and test_snapshot_submodules_watchdog_c605.py (4) fail with "DID NOT RAISE SnapshotError". evals/test_plan_replay_tier2.py (4), reconciler wiki-render/rich-text (7), test_gate_scratch_volume_aa40.py (2), and 11 singletons.
- No traceback section in the log (the xdist worker crashed): 7. These are test_doctor_locks.py (6) and test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py (1).

Why this stops here: the ticket's own approach is to re-measure after the larger class bugs land. Those bugs are in flight in other clusters this session: posix-shell (citreous-talented-wildebeest, Gerrit 3427/3428), text-encoding (obtuse-phenocryst-verdin), POSIX permissions, and A2's file-locks follow-ups. Moving lines into class files now would conflict with their deselect-file edits, and many of the 98 path-like matches are likely downstream of those classes. Next step: once those merge, dispatch one `sweep (windows)` run and re-run this classification on the remaining entries. The classifier script and the per-module triage are in the session scratch under `.rebar/scratch/05f74084-A3/` (local only).
